about: Skips the deploy gate accepts in CI (scripts/ci/gate.py). Every other skip fails the gate: in CI a skip usually means something the run was meant to have -- the server binary, Node, Lua, fastapi, PowerShell -- was missing, and the run tested less than it says. Each rule names the module, a test glob and a substring of the skip reason, and says why the skip is right there.

allowed.reason_contains: a sanitizer build reports crashes itself
allowed.why: Under ASan the crash handler is not installed (ASan's report is worth more); the same test runs in the normal shards against the Make binary.
